question: Which microfinance institution of India provides loans only against gold jewellery and provides foreign exchange services, money transfer, wealth management services, travel and tourism services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muthoot Finance Ltd.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muthoot Finance Ltd provides loans only against gold jewellery and provides foreign exchange services, money transfer, wealth management services, travel and tourism services.**
 
• **Gold jewellery loans:**
 
 
• Muthoot Finance Ltd provides loans only against gold jewellery.
 
• This means that customers can pledge their gold jewellery as collateral and get a loan against it.
 
 
 
• **Foreign exchange services:**
 
 
• Muthoot Finance Ltd also provides foreign exchange services where customers can buy and sell foreign currencies.
 
 
 
• **Money transfer:**
 
 
• Muthoot Finance Ltd provides money transfer services where customers can transfer money to other individuals or bank accounts.
 
 
 
• **Wealth management services:**
 
 
• Muthoot Finance Ltd provides wealth management services where customers can invest in various financial products such as mutual funds, fixed deposits, and insurance policies.
 
 
 
• **Travel and tourism services:**
 
 
• Muthoot Finance Ltd also provides travel and tourism services where customers can book flights, hotels, and holiday packages.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Microfinance institutions are financial institutions that provide financial services such as loans, savings, and insurance to low-income individuals or groups who typically lack access to traditional banking services.
 
• **Power Finance Corporation Ltd is a non-banking financial company that provides financial assistance to power projects and related activities.**
 
• Aditya Birla Finance Ltd is a non-banking financial company that provides financial services such as corporate finance, capital market finance, and wealth management.
 
• **Mahindra and Mahindra Financial Services Ltd is a non-banking financial company that provides financial services such as vehicle finance, home loans, and insurance.**
